label: zendesk ticket
title: zendesk-{num}
prompt: Read this zendesk ticket ({url}), summarize it here and in a ZENDESK-{num}.md file. List any attachments on the ticket and tell me whether there are any, then ask me which to download. Then let's figure out how you and I can make a plan to answer the customer.
notes: The url names no repository, so the directory defaults to openziti/ziti, where most tickets land. Change it in the dialog when the ticket belongs to another repo. No fetch: the agent reads the ticket through the zendesk tools it already has, and atrium holds no zendesk credential.

label: discourse topic
title: discourse-{num}
prompt: Read this discourse topic ({url}), summarize the question and what has been tried so far. Then let's figure out how you and I can make a plan to answer it.
notes: /t/<slug>/<id>, /t/<id> and a trailing post number all resolve to the topic id. The directory defaults to openziti/ziti, like a zendesk ticket. Change it in the dialog when the topic is about another repo.
